4009015.desc: Only experienced bears are allowed to wear these.

4009017.desc: A piece of a broken pot.

4009018.name: Ginseng Water
4009018.desc: A hot pot that contains water that's been boiling with ginseng for a long time.

4009019.name: Bellflower
4009019.desc: A common bellflower you can find in the mountains.

4009020.name: 100-Year-Old Bellflower
4009020.desc: A super old bellflower grown to be a hundred years old.

4009023.name: Marine Map Piece
4009023.desc: A piece of a pirate map.

4009024.name: Navigation Room Key
4009024.desc: Key to the pirates' Navigation Room.

4009025.name: Pirates's Voyage Log
4009025.desc: A voyage logbook of Lord Pirate's piracy activities

4009026.name: Lord Pirate's Hook
4009026.desc: Lord Pirate's hand, shaped like a hook.

4009027.name: Patrol Robot Memory Card
4009027.desc: A Patrol Robot's memory card. It's used to control the Robot.

4009028.name: Clean Water Bottle
4009028.desc: A water bottle stolen by the Water Thief.

4009029.name: Trash Bag
4009029.desc: A black trash bag that came out of a Dust Box.

4009030.name: Streetlight Structure
4009030.desc: A tentacle from the side of a Streetlight.

4009031.name: Patrol Robot S Memory Card
4009031.desc: A Patrol Robot S's memory card. It's used to control the Robot.

4009032.name: Guard Robot E's Memory Chip
4009032.desc: Guard Robot E's memory chip. It's used to control the Robot.

4009033.name: Trashy Thing
4009033.desc: A piece of trash from the Trash Can.

4009034.name: Wooden Plank
4009034.desc: A wooden board from the Strange Sign.

4009036.name: Safety First Board
4009036.desc: A sign carried by Safety First.

4009037.name: Rock Fragment
4009037.desc: A rock fragment obtained from Baby Boulder Muncher.

4009038.name: Ore Fragment
4009038.desc: A rock fragment obtained from Big Boulder Muncher. Looks like this can be carved into a jewel...

4009039.name: Boulder Shield
4009039.desc: A strong shield made from rocks.

4009040.name: Shovel
4009040.desc: A work shovel carried by Racoco.

4009041.name: Big Spider Antenna
4009041.desc: The antenna of a Big Spider.

4009042.name: Cart
4009042.desc: A cart pushed around by Cart Bears.

4009044.name: Safety Hat
4009044.desc: A safety hat worn by Raco.

4009045.name: Ore Muncher Sample
4009045.desc: A sample taken from an Ore Muncher.

4009046.name: Flaming Rue
4009046.desc: Rare Rue ore imbued with the heat and pressure of the underground.

4009047.name: Guard Robot L's Memory Chip
4009047.desc: Guard Robot L's memory chip. It's used to control the robot.

4009048.name: Security System Deactivation Key
4009048.desc: A card key that can be used to deactivate the Security System.

4009049.name: Security System Parts
4009049.desc: Parts that make up the Enhanced Security System.

4009050.name: Filament Lightbulb
4009050.desc: A broken bulb from the head of an Android.

4009052.name: Poison Gas
4009052.desc: Poison Gas created from a Poison Gas Generator.

4009060.name: Gelatin Blob
4009060.desc: A transparent blob of gelatin. Do not eat.

4009061.name: Red Megran Fruit
4009061.desc: A red fruit from Megran that is used as a rare medicine ingredient.

4009062.name: Rumo Leaf
4009062.desc: A rare leaf from Rumo. It's full of life, but loses it the more you handle it.

4009063.name: Test Flask
4009063.desc: A flask used for all kinds of fancy science-looking things.

4009064.name: Purple Liquid
4009064.desc: Unidentified purple liquid that might be toxic. Or delicious. Hard to tell.

4009065.name: Steel Fragment
4009065.desc: Iron Mutae are covered in this stuff.

4009066.name: Reinforced Steel Fragment
4009066.desc: Just try breaking this steel. I dare you.

4009067.name: Mithril Fragment
4009067.desc: This came from a Mithril Mutae, probably not by choice.

4009068.name: Reinforced Mithril Fragment
4009068.desc: Was part of a Reinforced Mithril Mutae, before you decided to recycle it.

4009069.name: Decayed Scorpion Stinger
4009069.desc: This scorpion stinger has seen better days.

4009070.name: Test Beaker
4009070.desc: A beaker that just REEKS of science.

4009071.name: Clean Dew
4009071.desc: You need this for Homunculus Alchemy. No one knows why.

4009072.name: Magic Blood
4009072.desc: Extracted from a Homunscullo. The enchantments have the ability to reveal truths.

4009073.name: Alchemy Stone
4009073.desc: A mystical stone forged by alchemy. It's a pretty safe bet that it contains some kind of power.

4009074.name: Decayed Wasp Stinger
4009074.desc: A nasty old stinger. Still looks dangerous.

4009076.name: Plug
4009076.desc: Even Neo Huroids need to be plugged in.

4009077.name: Broken Iron Heart
4009077.desc: A broken mechanical heart. It looks like it can be repaired and used again, if it can work through its issues.

4009078.name: Poacher Certificate
4009078.desc: Poachers carry these certificates around to tell each other apart.

4009079.name: Soft Cottons
4009079.desc: This Teddy Bear really spilled his guts.

4009080.name: Cute Panda Doll
4009080.desc: Looks just like a real panda!

4009081.name: Youngest Duckie
4009081.desc: A cute toy duck on wheels. Look at it go!

4009082.name: Plastic Toy Sword
4009082.desc: A toy soldier's plastic sword. Somewhat less effective than you current weapon.

4009083.name: Robo Battery
4009083.desc: Still has a little juice left in it.

4009084.name: Master Robo Battery
4009084.desc: Custom batteries are such a pain to replace.

4009086.name: Small Spring
4009086.desc: A tiny spring of a clock. Couldn't be THAT important.

4009087.name: Table Clock
4009087.desc: This thing just keeps on ticking.

4009088.name: Small Cog
4009088.desc: Just another cog in the machine...

4009089.name: Small Springy Worm
4009089.desc: A worm that feeds on time. Maybe it's a metaphor...

4009090.name: Clock Spring Component
4009090.desc: Grandpa Clock's still got some old springs kicking around. He really should get with the times.

4009091.name: Sealed Teddy
4009091.desc: This teddy bear is like a luxury suite for ghosts. For children 2 and up!

4009092.name: Shackled Paw
4009092.desc: This teddy paw was holding another teddy. It's bears all the way down.

4009093.name: Broken Teddy
4009093.desc: This plushy used to be possessed by a ghost. Don't worry, the ghost is gone. Probably.

4009094.name: Freed Spirit
4009094.desc: A spirit from the Soul Teddy. Looks pretty happy to be free.

4009095.name: Giant Grandpa Clock
4009095.desc: Big and unwieldy. Watches have come a long way from this.

4009096.name: Piece of Time
4009096.desc: You know how people always wish for more time? Well, here's your chance!

4009098.name: Hat Dealie-Bobber
4009098.desc: This ball popped right off of Lazy Buffy's hat. Like everything else in Maple World, it looks like it holds a mysterious power.

4009099.name: Alishar's Key
4009099.desc: How's Alishar supposed to get into his car now?!

4009100.name: Ghost Pirate Wheel
4009100.desc: Looks like those Ghost Pirates won't be going anywhere in a hurry.

4009101.name: Dual Ghost Pirate Wheel
4009101.desc: Good job dooming the Dual Ghost Pirates to drift aimlessly for eternity.

4009103.name: Dark Klock's Broken Clock
4009103.desc: Still right twice a day. But only about evil things.

4009104.name: Viking's Token
4009104.desc: Needed to get into all the coolest Viking parties.

4009105.name: Viking Helm
4009105.desc: You can smell the mead and sweat on this thing from a mile away.

4009106.name: Frozen Time
4009106.desc: Should still be good if you thaw it out.

4009107.name: Time Jar
4009107.desc: This can keep the Phantom Watch bottled up.

4009108.name: Damaged Hourglass
4009108.desc: It looks broken, but the sand doesn't spill out. Mysterious!

4009109.name: Memory Cloth
4009109.desc: The official colors of the Memory Monks.

4009110.name: Memory Cone Hat
4009110.desc: A hat that is worn by Memory Monk Trainees. Obviously a mark of respect.

4009111.name: Memory Helm
4009111.desc: A hat that is worn by Memory Guardians. Helps keep the memories in.

4009112.name: Memory Heart
4009112.desc: Heart of the Chief Memory Guardian. Doesn't he need this?

4009113.name: Dodo Helm
4009113.desc: The Whale of Time is rather fond of this hat.

4009114.name: Qualm Cloth
4009114.desc: The official colors of the Qualm Monks.

4009115.name: Qualm Cone Hat
4009115.desc: A hat that is worn by Qualm Monk Trainees. They have no qualms with it.

4009116.name: Qualm Helm
4009116.desc: A hat that is worn by Qualm Guardians. Keeps them qualm.

4009117.name: Qualm Heart
4009117.desc: Heart of the Chief Qualm Guardian. Kinda gross when you think about it.

4009118.name: Lilynouch Mask
4009118.desc: Protects the identity of Lilynouch, the Ice Knight.

4009119.name: Oblivion Cloth
4009119.desc: The official colors of the Oblivion Monks.

4009120.name: Oblivion Cone Hat
4009120.desc: A hat that is worn by Oblivion Monk Trainees. They seem oblivious to it.

4009121.name: Oblivion Helm
4009121.desc: A hat that is worn by Oblivion Guardians. Protects from oblivion-related injuries.

4009122.name: Oblivion Heart
4009122.desc: Heart of the Chief Oblivion Guardian. He might want it back at some point.

4009125.name: Griffey's Broken Horn
4009125.desc: A noble Griffey horn. Great for making jewelry.

4009132.name: Broken Blade (Blue)
4009132.desc: This would probably make a great weapon if it was still whole. Look at all those icy runes...

4009133.name: Broken Hilt (Blue)
4009133.desc: Imagine the weapon that must have been attached to this frozen thing.

4009134.name: Broken Shaft (Blue)
4009134.desc: All that's missing is the ball. Maybe it melted. Too bad that's the important part.

4009135.name: Broken Bow (Blue)
4009135.desc: Even as busted up as it is, this bow looks like it could shoot some wicked frosty arrows.

4009136.name: Broken Feather (Blue)
4009136.desc: Somehow this feather is as cold and heavy as a gigantic block of ice. Magic!

4009137.name: Broken Blade (Red)
4009137.desc: The runes on this thing are hot to the touch. What kind of weapon was it...?

4009138.name: Broken Hilt (Red)
4009138.desc: Despite the wrappings, this hilt is almost too hot to handle.

4009139.name: Broken Shaft (Red)
4009139.desc: Even without the ball, this thing is hot enough to do some damage.

4009140.name: Broken Bow (Red)
4009140.desc: You can tell by the markings that this bow used to shoot some white-hot arrows.

4009141.name: Broken Feather (Red)
4009141.desc: A decorative feather that's both hot and as heavy as a burning rock.

4009142.name: Broken Blade (Black)
4009142.desc: You're not sure what the runes on this say, but you get the feeling it's nothing good.

4009143.name: Broken Hilt (Black)
4009143.desc: This hilt feels terrible and threatening, despite not having anything dangerous attached to it.

4009144.name: Broken Shaft (Black)
4009144.desc: It's just a chain and a shaft, but they radiate such a sense of dread...

4009145.name: Broken Bow (Black)
4009145.desc: You can feel the agony of lost souls shot through with this ancient bow. Creepy.

4009146.name: Broken Feather (Black)
4009146.desc: A feather that weighs much more than it looks. It's also totally evil.

4009147.name: Basic Magician's Cloth
4009147.desc: Even cheap cloth like this is infused with magic. You can't throw a rock without hitting a magical artifact, it seems.

4009148.name: Intermediate Magician's Cloth
4009148.desc: This dark fabric radiates mysterious power. That makes sense, considering its intended use.

4009149.name: Advanced Magician's Cloth
4009149.desc: A piece of mysterious fabric surrounded by black energy. Guess evil magic is pretty popular these days.

4009150.name: Hawk Claw
4009150.desc: A sharp claw from a poacher's hawk.

4009151.name: Grave Robber Certificate
4009151.desc: Grave robbers carry these certificates around to tell each other apart.

4009152.name: Hunting Dog's Fang
4009152.desc: A fang from the grave robber's hunting dogs. Seems sharp enough to pierce anything.

4009153.name: Neon Bat Wings
4009153.desc: A pair of glowing wings from a Neon Bat. Might work like a flashlight in the dark.

4009154.name: Glowing Primary Rock Fragment
4009154.desc: A fragment of a glowing primary rock.

4009155.name: Spirit Substance
4009155.desc: A curious substance from a Peace Spirit.

4009156.name: Darkness Fragment
4009156.desc: This piece of darkness is thick with shadow.

4009157.name: Omen's Fragment
4009157.desc: You feel the same mysterious energy in this that you felt from the Omen.

4009158.name: Master Omen's Fragment
4009158.desc: You feel the same mysterious energy in this that you felt from the Master Omen.

4009159.name: Demolisher Part
4009159.desc: A part from the Barrier Demolisher.

4009160.name: Surveillance Robot Memory Chip
4009160.desc: This memory chip is all that's left of a Surveillance Robot.

4009169.name: Frozen Rose Petal
4009169.desc: A rose petal frozen from centuries in the snow. Doesn't seem tasty, so you might as well sell it at the shop.

4009170.name: Loose Chain
4009170.desc: An old chain that clangs around in your inventory. All that noise is making you mad. You should sell it at the shop.

4009171.name: Dried Rose Vine
4009171.desc: A dried rose vine. It makes the Golems look a bit prettier.

4009172.name: Shiny Flower Powder
4009172.desc: Shining bees drop  these shining powders. Maybe the shops will take this shiny thing for a lot of money.

4009173.name: Suspicious Lime Powder
4009173.desc: When you watch them closely, you can see that these lime powders are moving by themselves. Suspicious!

4009219.name: Dried Caterpillar
4009219.desc: Dried caterpillar jerky. It's a yummy food for baby foxes.

4009220.name: Spotted Wings
4009220.desc: These are the wings of a ladybug. They make good meals for baby foxes.

4009221.name: Sparrow Egg
4009221.desc: An egg stolen from a sparrow's nest. It makes a delicious treat for foxes.

4009222.name: Mouse Tail
4009222.desc: A tail from a Balloon Mouse. It's a yummy fox treat.

4009223.name: Red Frog Legs
4009223.desc: Frog legs from a Red Poison Frog. Be careful, they're poisonous all over.

4009224.name: Green Frog Legs
4009224.desc: Frog legs from a Green Poison Frog. Be careful, it's poisonous all over.

4009225.name: Mohawk Feather
4009225.desc: A fuzzy feather from a Delinquent Chick. It's covered in rebellious hair wax.

4009226.name: Rocker Feather
4009226.desc: A fuzzy feather from a Punk Chick. It's covered in hard rock hair wax.

4009227.name: Mane Fur
4009227.desc: Fur from a hyena's back. Nice spots.

4009228.name: Fang
4009228.desc: A long fang from a hyena. It symbolizes bravery, because someone had to go in there to get it.

4009229.desc: This sloppy Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket says #c'teeket'#. Lil Zakum needs some spelling lessons.
4009229.name: Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket

4009230.desc: A tail of an Evil Eye that used to live in the Ancient Cave. It's glossy and lustrous, unlike the tails of those other loser Evil Eyes.
4009230.name: Ancient Evil Eye Tail

4009231.desc: Drop it on the portal in the room to rotate the room's destination once clockwise.
4009231.name: Clockwise Labyrinth Key

4009232.name: Red Sand Powder
4009232.desc: Red Sand Powder dropped by a Red Sand Dwarf. Used to explore the 29th floor of the Tower of Oz. If you gather 10 Red Sand Powders, a Red Sand Crystal will appear beneath a tree on the left.

4009233.desc: Drop it on the portal in the room to rotate the room's destination once counterclockwise.
4009233.name: Counterclockwise Labyrinth Key

4009234.name: Yellow Leather
4009234.desc: A piece of yellow leather dropped by a Yellow Curly Cow. It's thin and light and doesn't tear easily. It would be great for clothing, but you have to use it to open the portal.

4009235.name: Purple Leather
4009235.desc: A piece of purple leather dropped by a Purple Curly Cow. It's a bit thick, but still looks luxurious. Get enough to escape the floor.

4009236.name: Orange Slime Liquid
4009236.desc: A substance from an Orange Ancient Slime. To summon an Orange Ancient Slime, gather 10 of these and drop them on the Burning Altar.

4009237.name: Ancient Blue Turtle Egg
4009237.desc: An Ancient Blue Turtle's egg. Would make quite an omelet.

4009238.name: Ancient Orange Turtle Egg
4009238.desc: An Ancient Orange Turtle's egg. Would make quite a breakfast.

4009239.desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Gold Richie's Safe Event.
4009239.name: Gold Richie Figure

4009240.desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Gold Richie's Safe Event.
4009240.name: Gold Richie Figure

4009241.desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Gold Richie's Safe Event.
4009241.name: Gold Richie Figure

4009242.desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Gold Richie's Safe Event.
4009242.name: Gold Richie Figure

4009281.name: Itchy Potion
4009281.desc: Nothing can resist the itch this nasty stuff causes. Use it to see how a Mushroom House reacts.

4009324.name: Black Heaven Entry Pass
4009324.desc: This Black Wings security pass will get you into most internal elevators.

4009325.desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Owner of the Safe event.
4009325.name: Gold Richie Figure

4009326.desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Owner of the Safe event.
4009326.name: Gold Richie Figure

4009327.desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Owner of the Safe event.
4009327.name: Gold Richie Figure

4009328.desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Owner of the Safe event.
4009328.name: Gold Richie Figure

4009343.name: Training Robot B Part
4009343.desc: A part that broke off of Training Robot B. It can be recycled.

4009377.name: Moonlight Posie
4009377.desc: A medicinal herb that's known for fast fatigue recovery. It turns poisonous after awhile, so deliver it to La Me in Mu Lung swiftly.

4009378.name: Contaminated Goblin Detritus
4009378.desc: Leavings of contaminated goblins. Drop contaminated goblin spirits one by one to grow the herb.

4009379.name: Candle Chest Key
4009379.desc: This key opens the chest with the candle. Drop the key next to the box in the Haunted Mansion Main Hall.

4009380.name: OMNI-CLN Component
4009380.desc: It's a piece of the OMNI-CLN.

4009429.name: Mateon's Tentacle
4009429.desc: Tentacles are Mateon's primary sensory and locomotive appendage.

4009430.name: Plateon's Helmet
4009430.desc: A helmet from a Plateon's environmental suit, necessary for survival in Maple World's atmosphere. The inside is slimy.

4009431.name: Space Food
4009431.desc: Food designed for the daily nutritional needs of aliens. Not for consumption by lifeforms with fewer than three stomachs.

4009432.name: Galactic Radio
4009432.desc: A device capable of broadcasting and receiving transmissions from space. There seems to be some trick to getting it to work.

4009433.name: Micro-Saucer Controller
4009433.desc: A device used for controlling miniature alien saucers. It appears to be wireless.

4009434.name: Mecateon's Laser Gun
4009434.desc: A laser gun wielded by Mecateons. There seems to be some trick to getting it to work.

4009435.name: MT-09 Fuel
4009435.desc: A can containing a mysterious substance used as fuel for an MT-09. From what you can tell, a little goes a long way.

4009436.name: Robosaucer Antenna
4009436.desc: A radio antenna used for recieving instructions. It's made from a material not known to Maple World.

4009454.name: Maple World Element: Grassland
4009454.desc: A primal material found within #cMaple World Elemental Crystals.# This material is filled with the very essence of Maple World's natural form, and can create a similar #cGrassland# environment on #cPetite Planet.#

4009455.name: Maple World Element: Mountain
4009455.desc: A primal material found within #cMaple World Elemental Crystals.# This material is filled with the very essence of Maple World's natural form, and can create a similar #cMountain# environment on #cPetite Planet.#

4009456.name: Maple World Element: Desert
4009456.desc: A primal material found within #cMaple World Elemental Crystals.# This material is filled with the very essence of Maple World's natural form, and can create a similar #cDesert# environment on #cPetite Planet.#

4009457.name: Maple World Element: Snowfield
4009457.desc: A primal material found within #cMaple World Elemental Crystals.# This material is filled with the very essence of Maple World's natural form, and can create a similar #cSnowfield# environment on #cPetite Planet.#

4009458.name: Maple World Element: Beach
4009458.desc: A primal material found within #cMaple World Elemental Crystals.# This material is filled with the very essence of Maple World's natural form, and can create a similar #cBeach# environment on #cPetite Planet.#

4009459.name: Maple World Element: Ocean
4009459.desc: A primal material found within #cMaple World Elemental Crystals.# This material is filled with the very essence of Maple World's natural form, and can create a similar #cOcean# environment on #cPetite Planet.#

4009461.name: Magic Stone
4009461.desc: A stone imbued with magic found on monsters in the Last Horizon area.\nYou can use it to recharge the Fleet Signal.\n#cYou can have up to 3#

4009463.name: 90시간 접속 보상 2배 증명서
4009463.desc: 2019년 1월 프리미엄 PC방에서 누적 접속 90시간 달성 시 #c보상을 2배#로 받을 수 있는 증명서이다.\n\n증명서를 분실하여도 1월 프리미엄 PC방 90시간 상자 사용 시 보상을 2배 받을 수 있으며, 증명서는 2019년 1월 31일 자동 소멸된다.

4009466.name: 15-Star Force Legendary Arcane Umbra Weapon Certificate
4009466.desc:
2019년 7월 26일에 시작되는 프리미엄 PC방 접속 이벤트에서 누적 접속 100시간 달성 시 획득 가능한 
#c7월 PC방 100시간 상자#에서 #c15성 레전드리 아케인셰이드 무기#를 선택할 수 있는 증명서이다.
본 증명서 소지 시 #c7월 PC방 100시간 상자#에서 아케인셰이드 무기, 앱솔랩스 무기, 도미네이터 펜던트 중 하나를 선택하여 획득할 수 있다.

증명서를 분실하여도 7월 PC방 100시간 상자 사용 시 아케인셰이드 무기를 선택할 수 있다.

4009497.name: Ancient Turtle Golden Eggs
4009497.desc: Golden eggs laid by Ancient Turtles.

4009487.name: Marauder Sword
4009487.desc: A sword used by Sloppy Marauder. The end is curved and suited for slashing.

4009537.name: Marauder Vest
4009537.desc: A vest worn by Ferocious Marauder. It's filthy and covered with dirt.

4009538.name: Marauder Wooden Club
4009538.desc: A wooden club used by Dangerous Marauder. It's made from solid wood.

4009539.name: Outlaw Spear
4009539.desc: A spear used by Suspicious Outlaw. It's sharper than it looks.

4009540.name: Outlaw Mask
4009540.desc: A mask used by Enraged Outlaw. It looks too heavy to wear for a long time.

4009541.name: Outlaw Hammer
4009541.desc: A hammer used by Menacing Outlaw. It seems difficult to hold with one hand.

4009546.name: Sol Erda
4009546.desc: Sol Erda came into being when the Erdas of Maple World and Grandis combined. It has spread all over the world.\nIt's used in activating or enhancing #c6th Job powers#.

4009547.name: Sol Erda Fragment
4009547.desc: A faint magical fragment that was left over when Sol Erda was formed.\nIt's used in activating or enhancing #c6th Job powers#.

4009626.name: Red Jewel
4009626.desc: A red gemstone that contains a mysterious power.

4009627.name: Green Jewel
4009627.desc: A green gemstone that contains a mysterious power.

4009628.name: Blue Jewel
4009628.desc: A blue gemstone that contains a mysterious power.

4009629.name: Purple Jewel
4009629.desc: A purple gemstone that contains a mysterious power.

4009630.name: Gray Jewel
4009630.desc: A gray gemstone that contains a mysterious power.

4009631.name: Prismatic Jewel
4009631.desc: A radiant multicolored gemstone that contains a mysterious power.

4009548.name: Sol Erda Fragment
4009548.desc: A faint magical fragment that was left over when Sol Erda was formed.\nIt's used in activating or enhancing #c6th Job powers#.

4009613.name: Sol Erda Fragment
4009613.desc: A faint magical fragment that was left over when Sol Erda was formed.\nIt's used in activating or boosting #cHEXA skills# and #cHEXA stats#.
4009613.desc_leftalign: #c* Open Advancement is unavailable while possessing Sol Erda Fragments extracted by a HEXA Matrix Reset Scroll.

4009615.name: Vestige of Erion
4009615.desc: A fragment of a weapon from the distant past.\nIt still has #cgreat power# within it, and the right blacksmith can draw that power out.

4010000.name: Bronze Ore
4010000.desc: Light, weak bronze ore. It can be refined to obtain rare brown magic powder.

4010001.name: Steel Ore

4220046.desc: This is Timer's egg. If you look closely in the half cracked shell, you'll see a baby Timer with wet feathers.

4220067.name: Moon
4220067.desc: An envelope used to contain a picture of the moon. Made out of durable paper that will not rip as a result of shock caused by jumping. Once you acquire a piece of the moon photo, double-click on it to open the envelope, then drag the piece of photo into it.

4220137.name: Mimiana Egg
4220137.desc: An egg of Mimiana, the Mount for knights. Watch the egg grow into a full-grown Mimiana by sharing your experiences with it. Once it matures into a full-grown creature, take it to Kiridu the Mount Trainer.

4220138.name: Glass Incubator
4220138.desc: A glass incubator where Mimiana is stored. Drag the food into the incubator to feed Mimiana. Once it matures, take it back to Kiridu the Mount Trainer.

4220139.name: Mimiana Egg
4220139.desc: An egg of Mimiana, the Mount for knights. Watch the egg grow into a full-grown Mimiana by sharing your experiences with it. Once it matures into a full-grown creature, take it to Kiridu the Mount Trainer.

4220145.name: Mimiana Egg
4220145.desc: An egg of Mimiana, the Mount for knights. Watch the egg grow into a full-grown Mimiana by sharing your experiences with it. Once it matures into a full-grown creature, take it to Kiridu the Mount Trainer.

4220146.name: Mimiana Egg
4220146.desc: An egg of Mimiana, the Mount for knights. Watch the egg grow into a full-grown Mimiana by sharing your experiences with it. Once it matures into a full-grown creature, take it to Kiridu the Mount Trainer.

4220148.name: Portrait of an Orange Mushroom
4220148.desc: Drawing paper on which you can draw a portrait of an Orange Mushroom. The portrait of an Orange Mushroom can be completed by using the Amazing, Mystical, or Magical watercolor paint on it. \r\n#cCan be opened by double-clicking on it with the mouse.#

4220149.name: Portrait of an Octopus
4220149.desc: Drawing paper on which you can draw a portrait of an Octopus. The portrait of an Octopus can be completed by using the Amazing, Mystical, or Magical watercolor paint on it. \r\n#cCan be opened by double-clicking on it with the mouse.#

4220150.name: Portrait of a Yeti
4220150.desc: Drawing paper on which you can draw a portrait of a Yeti. The portrait of a Yeti can be completed by using the Amazing, Mystical, or Magical watercolor paint on it. \r\n#cCan be opened by double-clicking on it with the mouse.#

4220151.name: Hanging Scroll
4220151.desc: A Hanging Scroll given to you by the Black Wing Shadow Warrior. The erased content can be restored by using special ink.\r\n#cCan be opened by double-clicking on it with a mouse.#

4220152.name: Rainbow Drawing
4220152.desc: A sheet of sketch paper covered in a rainbow.  \n#cDouble-click to open it.#

4220154.name: Warm Thermometer
4220154.desc: A thermometer that displays a person's heart. \r\n#cDouble-click to check the temperature.#

4220175.name: 6th Anniversary Jigsaw Puzzle
4220175.desc: The 6th Anniversary Jigsaw Puzzle. Complete the puzzle to see a picture of a birthday party.

4220178.name: Energy Cartridge
4220178.desc: An energy cartridge from an Android. Energy must be charged with EXP.

4220179.name: Mechanical Heart Part
4220179.desc: A mechanical heart from an android. Energy must be charged with EXP, just like the Energy Cartridge.

4220180.name: Halloween Candy Basket
4220180.desc: A basket for holding Halloween candy.

4220182.name: Powerful Warrior Marble
4220182.desc: Infused with a warrior's energy. Fills itself every time you hunt monsters within your level range. Hunt 3000 monsters to charge it completely.

4220183.name: Invincible Warrior Marble
4220183.desc: Infused with a warrior's energy. Fills itself every time you hunt monsters within your level range. Hunt 3000 monsters to charge it completely.

4220184.name: Wise Magician Marble
4220184.desc: Infused with a magician's energy. Fills itself every time you hunt monsters within your level range. Hunt 3000 monsters to charge it completely.

4220185.name: Awakened Magician Marble
4220185.desc: Infused with a magician's energy. Fills itself every time you hunt monsters within your level range. Hunt 3000 monsters to charge it completely.

4220186.name: Liberated Bowman Marble
4220186.desc: Infused with a bowman's energy. Fills itself every time you hunt monsters within your level range. Hunt 3000 monsters to charge it completely.

4220187.name: Soaring Bowman Marble
4220187.desc: Infused with a bowman's energy. Fills itself every time you hunt monsters within your level range. Hunt 3000 monsters to charge it completely.

4220195.name: Orange Mushroom Pot
4220195.desc: Orange Mushroom grows in this pot. Give Rainbow Dew to Orange Mushroom and watch it grow! Mu-mu-mu-mushroom!\r\n#cDouble-click# to check the Orange Mushroom Pot.

4220196.name: Small Bottle
4220196.desc: This is a Small Bottle that can be filled with Pure Water. When you get Pure Water from the Spring Sprite, the bottle will gradually fill up.\r\n#cDouble-click# to see how much Pure Water you've collected.

4220197.name: Small Bottle
4220197.desc: This is a Small Bottle that can be filled with Pure Water. When you get Pure Water from the Spring Sprite, the bottle will gradually fill up.\r\n#cDouble-click# to see how much Pure Water you've collected.

4220198.name: Small Bottle
4220198.desc: This is a Small Bottle that can be filled with Pure Water. When you get Pure Water from the Spring Sprite, the bottle will gradually fill up.\r\n#cDouble-click# to see how much Pure Water you've collected.

4220199.name: Cursed Spellbook
4220199.desc: Use the Sentsuma Juice Melky gave you to reveal the hidden text in the Cursed Spellbook.\r\n#cDouble-click# to check the Spellbook's contents.

4220200.name: Hanging Scroll
4220200.desc: A Hanging Scroll given to you by the Black Wing Shadow Warrior. The erased content can be restored by using special ink.\r\n#cCan be opened by double-\r\nclicking on it with a mouse.#

4260000.name: Basic Monster Crystal 1
4260000.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 31 ~ 50.

4260001.name: Basic Monster Crystal 2
4260001.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 51 ~ 60.

4260002.name: Basic Monster Crystal 3
4260002.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 61 ~ 70.

4260003.name: Intermediate Monster Crystal 1
4260003.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 71 ~ 80.

4260004.name: Intermediate Monster Crystal 2
4260004.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 81 ~ 90.

4260005.name: Intermediate Monster Crystal 3
4260005.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 91 ~ 100.

4260006.name: Advanced Monster Crystal 1
4260006.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 101 ~ 110.

4260007.name: Advanced Monster Crystal 2
4260007.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 111 ~ 120.

4260008.name: Advanced Monster Crystal 3
4260008.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 121 ~ 130.

4310000.name: Perfect Pitch
4310000.desc: This Music Note gives Inkwell the perfect pitch he's been dying to find. You can trade it for a rare item if you go to the Free Market Entrance or talk to Inkwell in Henesys before March 30th.

4310001.name: Icy Guitar Pick
4310001.desc: An icy blue guitar pick that will be exchanged when Inkwell returns.

4310002.name: 6th Anniversary Silver Coin
4310002.desc: A silver coin created to commemorate MapleStory's 6th Anniversary. It's only circulated during the 6th Anniversary period and has variety of uses.

4310007.name: Icy Guitar Pick
4310007.desc: An icy blue pick used for playing the guitar. You can take it to Mrs. Bo to purchase a special item.

4310008.name: Moonlight Coin
4310008.desc: A coin engraved with a full moon.

4310009.name: Noble Lion King Medal
4310009.desc: A medal containing Lion King's special power. It shines with a weak silver glow, as it hasn't been purified completely.

4310010.name: Royal Lion King Medal
4310010.desc: This purified golden medal contains Lion King's special power. Murt, in the Second Tower of Lion King's Castle, will accept it in exchange for Royal Von Leon equipment.

4310014.name: Snowdrop Coin
4310014.desc: A coin-shaped snowdrop. You can purchase items from Inkwell with these coins.

4310015.name: Gallant Emblem
4310015.desc: An emblem gifted by the god of war. An unknown power radiates from it.

4310016.name: Red Button
4310016.desc: A red button. These can be used to purchase items from Inkwell.

4310019.name: Tourist Memorial Coin
4310019.desc: A memorial coin distributed to the tourists of Maple World. Collecting these coins will come in handy later on.

4310020.name: Monster Park Commemorative Coin
4310020.desc: A special coin to commemorate the Monster Park. Take it to the Merchant at Monster Park to trade it for a special item.

4310021.name: Dolphin Island Commemorative Coin
4310021.desc: A commemorative coin given to visitors to Dolphin Island. The back of the coin features Pason's signature.\n#cGather up 4 and bring them to Pason to trade them for a Traveling Pouch.#

4310022.name: Cherry Blossom Commemorative Coin
4310022.desc: A commemorative coin given to those who visit the cherry blossoms. The back of the coin features the signature of Chief Stan.\n#cGather up 4 and bring them to Chief Stan to trade them for a Traveling Pouch.#

4310024.name: Treasure Hunt 'You Lose' Note
4310024.desc: A treasure hunt note featuring a picture of a bomb. That probably means it's no good.\n#cGather up the 'You Lose' notes and bring them to Hooper, the merchant, to trade them for food items.#

4310025.name: 7th Anniversary Coin
4310025.desc: A coin to commemorate MapleStory's 7th Anniversary. You can only find these during the 7th Anniversary celebration. You can use them to buy Joy Bird Feathers, which Inkwell can then use to upgrade Maple Beryl equipment into Crimson Maple equipment.

4310027.name: Legends Awards Coin
4310027.desc: A coin used during the Legends Awards. Can be used to purchase various useful items in the Legends Shop.

4310028.name: Legends Maple Coin
4310028.desc: A special currency used during the Legends event. You can use it from the Maple Tab in the Legends Shop.

4310029.name: Crusader Coins
4310029.desc: You can exchange this for Silent Crusade items from Wence at the Silent Crusade Safe House. Silent Crusade items can also be exchanged through the Maple Administrator.\n\n#cCan be exchanged until 1/31/2024#.

4310030.name: Homecoming Coin
4310030.desc: A special sporty coin that can be exchanged for equipment and scrolls from Inkwell.

4310034.name: Renegades Coin
4310034.desc: A coin used during the Renegades Festival. Can be used to purchase various useful items in the Renegades Shop.

4310036.name: Conqueror's Coin
4310036.desc: Coin obtained by clearing Fight for Azwan. Used to purchase rare Azwan items.

4310038.name: Emperor's Coin
4310038.desc: Coin obtained by clearing the Fight for Azwan on Hard Mode. Used to purchase rare Azwan items.

4310048.name: 8th Anniversary Coin
4310048.desc: Coin released in celebration of 8th Maple Anniversary. Only used during 8th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase Maple armors and other special items from Inkwell.

4310057.name: Tempest Coin
4310057.desc: Newly minted to celebrate the Tempest Festival. Allows you to purchase various limited-time items during the festival.

4310058.name: Magnus Coin
4310058.desc: A coin that you obtained for defeating Magnus. Talk to Mayala at Downtown Black Market to trade it in.

4310059.name: Shadowdealer Coin
4310059.desc: A secret coin obtained for helping the Shadowdealers. Talk to Mayala at Downtown Black Market to trade it in.

4310060.name: Evolving Coin
4310060.desc: Turn this in to Vendor-C2 in the Evolution Lab for Cores, Equipment, and Scrolls.\n\n#cCan be exchanged until 1/31/2024#

4310061.name: 2014 Homecoming Coin
4310061.desc: Turn this in to Wonky in the Event Hall for sports equipment and scrolls.

4310063.name: Step Pop Coin
4310063.desc: Turn this in to NPC Lux in town for valuable items. Lux's items change every 2 hours.\nVisit the Free Market Entrance in Channel 1 to find Lux.

4310064.name: Yggdrasil Rune
4310064.desc: An ancient stone engraved with Yggdrasil's rune. Trade it to the merchant at Colossal Root in the Root Abyss for a Sealed Box.

4310065.name: Chaos Yggdrasil Rune
4310065.desc: An ancient stone engraved with Chaos Yggdrasil's rune. Trade it to the merchant at Colossal Root in the Root Abyss for a Sealed Box.

4310066.name: Unleashed Coins
4310066.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls, equipment, and Mastery Books from the Solar Power Coin Shop.

4310067.name: PC Cafe Coin
4310067.desc: 프리미엄 PC방에서만 획득 가능한 코인 아이템이다. 린에게서 주문서, 장신구 등으로 교환할 수 있다.

4310069.name: Monster Life Coin
4310069.desc: Coin purchased with Monster Life Warus. Used to purchase goods from Jimmy-Jack.

4310070.name: New Year's Yut Coin
4310070.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls, equipment, and Mastery Books from the New Year's Coin Shop.

4310071.name: New Year's Kite Coin
4310071.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls and equipment from the New Year's Coin Shop.

4310079.name: 9th Anniversary Coins
4310079.desc: Coin released in celebration of 9th Maple Anniversary. Only used during 9th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase Maple armors and other special items from Inkwell.

4310080.name: 9th Anniversary Maple Leaf
4310080.desc: A beautiful maple leaf. #cYou can trade it for 9th Anniversary Coins from Inkwell, but only during the event period.#

4310085.name: Time Coin
4310085.desc: A coin imbued with the power of time. Zero, from Cello in Zero's Temple, will accept it in exchange for supplies.

4310086.name: Job Advancement Coin
4310086.desc: This coin is required for Open Advancement, which is only available for Explorers.

4310088.name: RED Coin
4310088.desc: A red coin with the letters RED imprinted on it. #cYou can use it to buy items at the RED Shop.#

4310091.name: Anheim Coin
4310091.desc: A coin minted by the Ranheim Magic School. Keilbarren, in Kritias Marketplace, accepts these coins in exchange for anti-magic and other useful items.

4310092.name: Kritias Commemorative Coin
4310092.desc: A very valuable coin minted by the Kritias Government. Keilbarren, in Kritias Marketplace, accepts these coins in exchange for special items.

4310095.name: Silver Farm Coin
4310095.desc: A silver coin only usable in the goose farm. You can use them when purchasing special items at the goose farm. Talk to the farm owner.

4310099.name: Spring Bunny Coin
4310099.desc: Take these coins to the Spring Bunny Salesman in the Event Hall to get rare items. Can only be used during the Spring Event period.

4310102.name: Mustache Comb
4310102.desc: Carlton the mustache researcher is looking for this comb. You can trade this for a special item at Carlton's Mustache Lab.

4310103.name: Mustache Scissors
4310103.desc: Carlton the mustache researcher is looking for these scissors. You can trade them for a special item at Carlton's Mustache Lab.

4310108.name: Nut Coin
4310108.desc: These coins are the future! Their value can only go up! Use them buy special items from Roasty the Nut Merchant.

4310113.name: Carrot Coin
4310113.desc: A coin featuring a fresh-looking carrot mark. Use them buy special items from Roasty the Nut Merchant.

4310119.name: 10th Anniversary Coin
4310119.desc: A coin released to mark the 10th Maple Anniversary. Only used during the 10th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase special items.

4310124.name: Hugh Head's Gold Needle
4310124.desc: A gold needle from Hugh Head. You can trade it to him for new uniforms.

4310125.name: Hugh Head's Silver Needle
4310125.desc: A silver needle from Hugh Head. You can trade it to him for new uniforms.

4310129.name: Winter Limited Coin
4310129.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls, damage skins, and chairs from the Winter Limited Coin Shop.

4310153.name: FIREPOWER Coin
4310153.desc: This coin is available during the FIREPOWER event. It can be used to purchase various items from the Coin Commissary, Korean Folk Town, and more.

4310154.name: FIREPOWER SP Coin
4310154.desc: This coin is #ca very special one# from the FIREPOWER event. It can be used to purchase exclusive items from Agent Burns.

4310156.name: AbsoLab Coin
4310156.desc: Three-Hands, in Haven, accepts these coins in exchange for official AbsoLab equipment.

4310163.name: 11th Anniversary Coin
4310163.desc: A coin released to mark the 11th Maple Anniversary. Only used during the 11th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase special items.

4310172.name: Pepe Coin
4310172.desc: Purchase special items from Pepe at the 2015 Summer Main Town and Monster Treasure Town.

4310175.name: Star M Coin
4310175.desc:
#cEvent Period: 
Until TKTKTK#

#cStar M Coin Shop Available:
Until TKTKTK#

A special coin that can be acquired from Star Planet M. Purchase various items during the event period.

4310184.name: World Traveler Coin
4310184.desc: A coin from the year 2015! Travel the world to scrounge these up, and use them to purchase special items from the Coin Shop.

4310185.name: 2016 Rice Cake Festival Coin
4310185.desc: A coin printed in the year 2016! They mark the celebration of the rice festival. Use them to purchase special items from the Coin Shop.

4310195.name: Heroes Coin
4310195.desc: This coin is available during the summer event. It can be used to purchase various items from the Heroes Coin Shop.

4310198.name: Rice Drop Soup Coin
4310198.desc: A big coin engraved with the image of a delicious-looking rice drop soup. It can be traded to Pink Mong for various items.

4310199.name: Stigma Coin
4310199.desc: Stigma coin that can be traded for AbsoLab equipment. Talk to the Demon Supplier in Deserted Camp.

4310201.name: Broken Gold Fragment
4310201.desc: A fragment broken off of a golden statue. You can exchange it for items from Lil Murgoth.

4310206.name: 12th Anniversary Coin
4310206.desc: A limited-edition coin released to mark MapleStory's 12th Anniversary. It can be used during the 12th Anniversary to purchase special items.

4310210.name: V Coin
4310210.desc: A summer event coin that has a clear V mark. Take it to Wave to trade it for a special item.

4310213.name: M-Force Go!
4310213.desc: Grants a chance for M-Forcers to deal a finishing blow. Drops 5,000 bonus mesos.

4310214.name: Ultra Beam
4310214.desc: Places a Revolving Cannon designed by Dr. Kim. Drops 10,000 bonus mesos when the enemy is defeated.

4310215.name: Mesotron-X
4310215.desc: Summons the giant robot Mesotron-X, which fires lasers in all directions every time you press the skill button. Drops 20,000 bonus mesos when the enemy is defeated.

4310216.name: AbsoLab Essence
4310216.desc: Contains the essence of AbsoLab equipment. Used to upgrade Lapis/Lazuli for Zero.

4310217.name: Arcane Umbra Essence
4310217.desc: Contains the essence of Arcane Umbra equipment. Used to upgrade Lapis/Lazuli for Zero.

4310218.name: Phantasma Coin
4310218.desc: Dimo, on Lachelein Main Street, accepts these coins in exchange for official Arcane Umbra equipment.

4310221.name: Persimmon Coin
4310221.desc: A fall event coin that depicts a delicious persimmon. Bring it to Mommy Moon Bunny to exchange it for something special.

4310225.name: Override Coin
4310225.desc: It's a shiny Override Event Coin! You can trade it for various special items at the #cOverride Coin Shop# run by Yeti.

4310227.name: Dream Coin
4310227.desc: A coin you received for taking on Dream Defender. You can trade it for rewards with Mr. Flopsy, the Dreamweaver.

4310228.name: Magpie Coin
4310228.desc: It's a Magpie Coin depicting an adorable magpie. You can exchange it for various and special items at the #New Year's Coin Shop# run by Magnus the Magpie.

4310229.name: Legion Coin
4310229.desc: A coin acquired with your Legion's hard work and cooperation.\r\nYou can exchange it for various items or use it to increase your Legion rank at #cDame Appropriation and Squire Pancho in major towns#.

4310235.name: Spirit Coin
4310235.desc: A coin earned by rescuing a Rock Spirit in Spirit Savior. You can exchange these for Arcane Symbols from the <Escaped Rock Spirit> NPC.

4310237.name: Nova Coin
4310237.desc: It's a Nova Event Coin! You can redeem it for special items at the #cNova Coin Shop#, run by Manoff.

4310241.name: Pop Coin
4310241.desc: A Pop Coin obtained for participating in the Maple Film Festival. It can be exchanged for special items in Ring Master Orchid's #cKing of the Rings Coin Shop.#

4310244.name: Ghost Coin
4310244.desc: Trade this in for special items like the Halloween-themed items at the #cGhoulbuster Coin Shop# run by Hallowkitty.

4310248.name: Ark Coin
4310248.desc: It's an Ark Event Coin! You can redeem it for special items at the #cArk Coin Shop#.

4310249.name: Arachno Coin
4310249.desc: Dimo, at the Base Camp in Esfera, accepts these coins in exchange for official Arcane Umbra equipment.

4310253.name: 14th Street Coin
4310253.desc: You'll get 14th Street Coin x1 for every 14th Street Point x100 earned.

4310257.name: Alliance Medal
4310257.desc: A medal given by the Alliance to heroes that have gathered the power of determination. You can use Alliance Medals to increase your Alliance Rank or to purchase items from the Alliance Supply Depot.

4310260.name: Genesis Essence
4310260.desc: Contains the essence of Genesis equipment. Used to upgrade Lapis/Lazuli for Zero.

4310261.name: Utah Coin
4310261.desc: You'll get 1 Utah Coin for every 100 Utah Points earned.

4310266.name: Adventure Coin
4310266.desc: You'll get 1 Adventure Coin for every 100 Adventure Points earned.

4310269.name: Pixel Coin
4310269.desc: A currency made from crystallized #cPixel Power#. It can be used for various purposes in Pixel Kingdom.\n\n#c1 Pixel Coin is obtained for every 100 Pixel Power gathered.

4310272.name: Glory Coin
4310272.desc: A coin given to members of the Glory Guard as a reward for carrying out missions. It can be used to purchase items from the Alliance Supply Depot, or increase one's Glory Guard rank.

4034744.desc: If you need to wake up in a hurry, this potent brew will do the trick!

4034745.name: Lights
4034745.desc: Festive light bulbs used for tree decorations. They can make anything look good.

4034746.name: Ornaments
4034746.desc: Ornaments used for tree decorations. They're so sparkly!

4034747.name: Glitter
4034747.desc: Glitter to sprinkle on the tree. Somehow even more sparkly than the ornaments!

4034748.name: Wake-up Pill
4034748.desc: When Wake-up Juice won't do the trick, try the prescription-strength version!

4034749.name: Children's Autograph
4034749.desc: An autograph book filled with autographs supporting Mas.

4034856.name: Lost Specter's Handkerchief
4034856.desc: A keepsake that belongs to an innocent Specter.\r\nWhy does the Spooky Specter need this?

4034857.name: Unholy Water
4034857.desc: This is the strange black water Nue has been passing out to Specters. Said to improve skin softness, increase lifespan, and cure all sorts of otherworldly maladies. Only a handful are given out at sermons, so it is especially hard to come by.

4034858.name: The Gospel of Nue
4034858.desc: Supposedly, the religious text of Nue's followers. For a holy book, it seems sloppily transcribed.

4034859.name: Dusk Viper Venom
4034859.desc: Venom from a Dusk Viper that lives near Grieving Grotto.\nTake this to the Spooky Specter to exchange it for Unholy Water.

4034860.name: Crazed Oni Mask
4034860.desc: A mask obtained by defeating Crazed Oni.  \n#cUsed to restore a broken Sacred Idol. #

4034861.name: Berserk Oni Mask
4034861.desc: A mask obtained by defeating Berserk Oni.  \n#cUsed to restore a broken Sacred Idol. #

4034862.name: Suspicious Oni Mask
4034862.desc: A mask obtained by defeating Suspicious Oni.  \n#cUsed to restore a broken Sacred Idol. #

4034863.name: Fire Extinguisher
4034863.desc: An old fire extinguisher. It looks like just air's coming out. \n#cYou can use it to remove the dust.  #

4034864.name: Gas Can
4034864.desc: An empty gas can. \n#c Until recently, it was full of gas. #

4034865.name: Hose
4034865.desc: A hose attached to the gas can. It's relatively clean, and longer than you thought.

4034866.name: Mysterious Key
4034866.desc: It isn't clear what this key is used for.

4034867.name: Strange Key
4034867.desc: It isn't clear what this key is used for.

4034872.name: Sakura's Treasure
4034872.desc: Sakura received this from her father as a gift when he returned from a business trip in a distant land. It is one of her most treasured possessions.

4034873.name: Stompin' Rock
4034873.desc: This rock looks perfectly shaped for training on top of. You know, like you normally do with rocks.

4034874.name: Foxwhisker Herb
4034874.desc: An herb use in medicine by the Fox Yokai.

4034881.name: Empty Water Bottle
4034881.desc: An empty bottle to hold water from the Fountain of Life, which is located in the deepest part of the forest.\r\nThe Fountain of Life is to said to have #cgreenish water.

4034882.name: Full Water Bottle
4034882.desc: A bottle filled with water from the Fountain of Life! \r\nSome plants in Spring Valley require water from the Fountain of Life to flourish.

4034883.name: Empty Crystal Bottle
4034883.desc: This crystal bottle was specifically crafted to capture sunshine. #cIt takes about 30 minutes to soak in the sun's rays.

4034884.name: Full Crystal Bottle
4034884.desc: The bottle is full of sunshine!\r\nSome plants in Spring Valley require sunshine to thrive.

4034893.name: Strange Animal Fur
4034893.desc: The animal fur that Zen mentioned. Collect it to find out where Lingling went.

4034894.name: Mana Particles
4034894.desc: Mana Particles left behind by Nenne. Collect them to find out where Nenne went.

4034895.name: Litter
4034895.desc: This is the litter that Mrs. Ming Ming mentioned. Collect it all and return it to her.

4034896.name: Monster Kindergarten Hat Piece
4034896.desc: A piece of the hats that the Monster Kindergarteners were wearing. Collect and bring 10 of these pieces to Mrs. Ming Ming and she will turn them into a hat.

4034897.name: Valuable Loot
4034897.desc: Loot used to pay Bounty Hunter Jett.

4034900.name: JM's Deck
4034900.desc: This deck is part of JM's DJ equipment.

4034901.name: JM's Mixer
4034901.desc: This mixer is part of JM's DJ equipment.

4034902.name: JM's Headphones
4034902.desc: It's DJ JM's favorite pair of headphones.

4034903.name: JM's Laptop
4034903.desc: It's a laptop used by DJ JM.

4034904.name: JM's Speaker (L)
4034904.desc: This left speaker is part of JM's DJ equipment.

4034905.name: JM's Speaker (R)
4034905.desc: This right speaker is part of JM's DJ equipment.

4034906.name: JM's Lighting Rig
4034906.desc: This lighting rig belongs to DJ JM.

4034907.name: Maplehood Watch Coupon Fragment
4034907.desc: It's a Maplehood Watch Coupon Fragment stolen by monsters. You can trade the pieces in for a fresh coupon.

4034913.name: Maplehood Watch Coupon Fragment
4034913.desc: It's an Maplehood Watch Coupon Piece stolen by monsters. You can trade the pieces in for a fresh coupon.

4034975.name: Monster's Anguish
4034975.desc: [Item used in Secret Stories]\r\nIt's a glob of concentrated anguish.\r\nThe Girl said it's used in making a potion that channels the dead...

4034976.name: Eau de Mort
4034976.desc: [Item used in Secret Stories]\r\nIt's the concentrated stench of death and decay.\r\nApparently it's needed for the ritual.

4034977.name: Lumber for Repairs
4034977.desc: [Item used in Secret Stories]\r\nIt's lumber to be used for repairing the buildings damaged by the Snow Monster.

4034978.name: Stone for Repairs
4034978.desc: [Item used in Secret Stories]\r\nIt's stone to be used for repairing the buildings damaged by the Snow Monster.

4034992.name: Balrog's Key
4034992.desc: A small golden key that was hanging from around a Balrog's neck. It looks a little too small to open a lock on the Huge Door. Maybe it opens a lock for something smaller, like a diary?

4034993.name: Warrior's Token
4034993.desc: This fancy trinket serves as proof that its bearer is a warrior without peer.

4034994.name: Food Basket
4034994.desc: The food basket recovered from a Moustrosity.

4034995.name: Treasure Basket
4034995.desc: A treasure basket recovered from a Moustrosity.

4034996.name: Child's Toy
4034996.desc: A toy that a Papercraft critter was playing with. A child might want this.

4034997.name: Frozen Treat
4034997.desc: A frozen treat the Papercraft critter was carrying. Looks tasty!

4034998.name: Bleached Olive Tree
4034998.desc: A withered-looking olive tree. It appears to have lost all color.

4034999.name: Black Raven Feather
4034999.desc: A raven's feather. It's as black as the night.

4036000.name: Adler's White Key
4036000.desc: A white key you received from Adler. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036001.name: Lightning-Touched Wooden Key
4036001.desc: A key discovered inside a tree in the Land of Innocence after a thunderstorm.\r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036002.name: God of Battle's Key
4036002.desc: A key given to you in the Land of Warriors when you were mistaken for the 'God of Battle' in your enlarged state. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036003.name: Golden Key
4036003.desc: A key found among Mansa's treasure-puke pile. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036004.name: Raven Black Key
4036004.desc: A pitch-black key swallowed by a raven. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036005.name: Crystalline Key
4036005.desc: A flashy crystalline key found inside a diary. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036006.name: Cast Iron Key
4036006.desc: A key made of cast iron given to you by Horemheb, the wealthiest person in the Land of Riches. It was the least valuable of his possessions. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036007.name: Yellow Mage's Key
4036007.desc: The Yellow Mage's plastic key. It feels cheap, but it's bursting with malevolent energy. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036008.name: Carved Stone Key
4036008.desc: An old man who carves tombstones carved this key out of stone. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036009.name: Molded Clay Key
4036009.desc: An old man who carves tombstones molded this key from clay. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036010.name: Heart-shaped Key
4036010.desc: A heart-shaped toy key you received from a child in the Land of Innocence. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036011.name: Striped Candy Key
4036011.desc: A key made of striped candy you got from a child in the Land of Innocence. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

4036012.name: Color Collector
4036012.desc: A handy-dandy color collector capable of sucking the color right out of a monster.

4036013.name: Filled Color Collector
4036013.desc: The color collector is full of various colors harvested from monsters.

4036014.name: Battle Balrog's Armor
4036014.desc: A sturdy-looking set of Balrog-sized armor.

4036015.name: Brand New Teddy Bear
4036015.desc: A brand new teddy bear from Sunni's store. It's soft and huggable.

4036016.name: Tina's Lost Storybook
4036016.desc: This must be Tina's storybook. It's hard to tell though, as the color is in rough shape.

4036017.name: Emilia's Insignia
4036017.desc: An insignia signifying a candidate for the Kingdom of Lugunica's royal election.

4036022.name: Smoked Mystery Meat Bone
4036022.desc: This once meaty bone has been picked clean!

4036029.name: Roswaal's Magical Ore
4036029.desc: One of the 5 magical materials requested by Roswaal.

4036030.name: Roswaal's Magic Crystal
4036030.desc: One of the 5 magical materials requested by Roswaal.

4036031.name: Roswaal's Mandarin Flower
4036031.desc: One of the 5 magical materials requested by Roswaal.

4036032.name: Roswaal's Oil Bottle
4036032.desc: One of the 5 magical materials requested by Roswaal.

4036033.name: Roswaal's Magic Powder
4036033.desc: One of the 5 magical materials requested by Roswaal.

4036034.name: Shimmering Dragon Diamond
4036034.desc: It's a gorgeous, sparkling Diamond. It could be useful against monsters that like shiny things.

4036035.name: Festive Present
4036035.desc: A Festive present Krampus carried to distribute to nice adults. Of course, he hasn't quit his day-job!

4036036.name: Sardine
4036036.desc: This little sardine is precious to the Ice Pepe Siblings, who are gathering tons of them for an unknown purpose.

4036037.name: The Mistress' Icicle
4036037.desc: Once upon a time, a 50-million-year-old icicle was granted life, and became the Mistress of Ice. It's said the icicle formed slowly, growing 0.0001 mm every year. Someone has been writing bits of her legend down on paper and spreading it around. Something amazing will occur when you gather all of the papers and speak the three-digit password.\r\n\r\n#cThere's a number written on the icicle but you can't make it out.#

4036040.name: Snow Rabbit Leaf
4036040.desc: This leaf was once a Snow Rabbit's ear. Didn't anyone tell you? Leaves are murder!

4036041.name: Bottled Blue Flame
4036041.desc: Fogo Azul or one of his lookalikes was sucked into this bottle and trapped.

4036042.name: Black Annis' Staff
4036042.desc: It's a staff once wielded by Black Annis.

4036043.name: Rimos Shorts
4036043.desc: A pair of inexplicably stylish shorts worn by Rimos. They smell a little funky.

4036044.name: The Mistress' Icicle
4036044.desc: Once upon a time, a 50-million-year-old icicle was granted life, and became the Mistress of Ice. It's said the icicle formed slowly, growing 0.0001 mm every year. Someone has been writing bits of her legend down on paper and spreading it around. Something amazing will occur when you gather all of the papers and speak the three-digit password. \r\n\r\n#cThe number '7' has been carved into the icicle.#

4036045.name: The Mistress' Icicle
4036045.desc: Once upon a time, a 50-million-year-old icicle was granted life, and became the Mistress of Ice. It's said the icicle formed slowly, growing 0.0001 mm every year. Someone has been writing bits of her legend down on paper and spreading it around. Something amazing will occur when you gather all of the papers and speak the three-digit password. \r\n\r\n#cThe number '3' has been carved into the icicle.#

4036046.name: The Mistress' Icicle
4036046.desc: Once upon a time, a 50-million-year-old icicle was granted life, and became the Mistress of Ice. It's said the icicle formed slowly, growing 0.0001 mm every year. Someone has been writing bits of her legend down on paper and spreading it around. Something amazing will occur when you gather all of the papers and speak the three-digit password. \r\n\r\n#cThe number '2' has been carved into the icicle.#

4036047.name: Unfinished Stone
4036047.desc: A slab of stone. This ought to work well for carving tombstones.

4036048.name: Strange Snow Crystal
4036048.desc: It's a crystal formed from compacted snow. There seems to be a secret power hidden within it.

4036049.name: Magic Eyepatch
4036049.desc: This magical eyepatch will dispel any fear! As long as it's a fear of heights.

4036050.name: El Nath Unmeltable Ice Shard
4036050.desc: A chunk of unmeltable ice from El Nath.

4036051.name: Fiendly Flu Medicine
4036051.desc: It's a carrot-flavored cold medicine.\r\nIt's seems to be a miracle cure against the disease the Frost Fiends carry.

4036052.name: Refined Snow Crystal Sample
4036052.desc: A sample refined from 50 Snow Crystals. Who's ready for some science!?

4036053.name: Completing quests for The Afterlands awards 30% Bonus EXP
4036053.desc: The Afterlands are now available! 30% Bonus EXP will be granted for completing all Afterlands quests!

4036069.name: Sweetheart Choco
4036069.desc:
A sweet chocolate to share with a loved one.
Allegedly, eating this fills you with power and extends your lifespan.
You can eat it using the Choco Syringe.
#c'Valentine's Day is not about sharing chocolate!'"#

4036104.name: Aspire Visitor's ID
4036104.desc: A visitor ID Badge that allows you to enter the headquarters of Aspire Industries, creators of the #cWondroid#.

4036107.name: Model 13's Key
4036107.desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 13 at #cAspire#.

4036108.name: Model 6's Key
4036108.desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 6 at #cAspire#.

4036109.name: Model 82's Key
4036109.desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 82 at #cAspire#.

4036110.name: Work Order
4036110.desc: A work order used for work on the #cWondroid# project at #cAspire Industries#.

4036111.name: Wondroid Research Diary
4036111.desc: A research diary detailing the entire creation and development of the #cWondroid# at #cAspire Industries#.\r\n#c[Classified TOP SECRET]\r\nClearance Level 3#

4036112.name: Rune-Engraved Elunite Crystal
4036112.desc: An Elunite Crystal engraved with alien runes. It feels unlike any other Elunite Crystal you've discovered.

4036113.name: Churmble Specimen
4036113.desc: A research sample harvested from the crystal-coated Eluna lifeform known as a 'Churmble.'

4036114.name: Thalia Floatyfish Specimen
4036114.desc: A research sample from the 'Thalia Floatyfish.' It looks more like a monster than a plant.

4036115.name: Deadly Biteysnek Specimen
4036115.desc: A research sample from the 'Deadly Biteysnek'. It appears to be capable of asexual reproduction at a cellular level, explaining the lifeform's abundance on this planet. Smells like chicken.

4036116.name: Captured Churmble
4036116.desc: Churmble that has been successfully captured and placed in a cage. You feel kind of bad, but science requires sacrifice.

4036117.name: Captured Atlassian Crab
4036117.desc: Atlas that has been successfully captured and put in a cage. That's no drab little crab. It's as shiny as they come.

4036118.name: Spaceflight Research Laboratory Photo
4036118.desc: A photo of a ruined facility that appears to have once been used to research spaceflight.

4036119.name: Photo of Water Filtration Facility Ruins
4036119.desc: A photo of a ruined facility that appears to have once been used to extract and purify water.

4036121.name: Dark Residue
4036121.desc: It's a dark residue commonly obtained from the monsters found at Gold Beach.

4036122.name: Old Bone Fragment
4036122.desc: It's an old bone fragment that can be obtained from monsters at the Excavation Site. Despite its shabby appearance, it has great archaeological value.

4036123.name: Drake Tissue Sample
4036123.desc: It's a tissue harvested from a Drake. Apparently it's quite valuable for biological research.

4036124.name: Artificial Organism Tissue Sample
4036124.desc: It's a tissue sample from an artificial organism created by way of alchemy. It could be quite valuable for study.

4036125.name: Mechanical Lifeform Component
4036125.desc: A component from a mechanical lifeform. It appears to have been crafted through the synergy of alchemy and engineering.

4036126.name: Horntail's Evil Energy
4036126.desc: It's an energy commonly found from monsters in Minar Forest influenced by Horntail. How you managed to collect it, only the developers can answer.

4036127.name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
4036127.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology. It's calibrated to interface with the data collector in the Swamp Region.

4036128.name: Photo of Stellar Observatory Ruins
4036128.desc: A photo of a ruined structure that appears to have once been used to study the stars.

4036129.name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
4036129.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data from the Swamp Region.

4036130.name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
4036130.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  Use it to collect data on Drake monsters.

4036131.name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
4036131.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data on Drake monsters.

4036132.name: Lidium Sample
4036132.desc: It's the Lidium ore that Eremos asked you to obtain.

4036133.name: Ryuul Mobile Data Collector
4036133.desc: It's a Ryuul data storage device that's been jury-rigged into a mobile data collector. You can use it to record data on the enemies you fight in Ellin Forest.\r\n\r\nApparently it's powered by a micro-singularity, so unless you're looking to destroy two versions of Maple World at once, maybe don't break it.

4036134.name: Zakum Fragment Sample
4036134.desc: It's a fragment of Zakum's statue you collected for Eremos. He seemed eager to analyze it.

4036135.name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
4036135.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  Use it to collect data on the Minar Forest region.

4036136.name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
4036136.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data on the Minar Forest region.

4036308.name: Master Chef Feedback
4036308.desc: Use these to have your Absolute Taste dish reviewed by the only food critic who counts, Chef Gourdon Ritzy himself. You'll need a new one for every time you get his feedback.

4140001.name: Safety Charm
4140001.desc: It does not let the user lose EXP points after death, as long as it's in possession. 30% of your HP and MP will be recovered when you are revived. This item is consumed upon use.

4140400.name: Safety Charm
4140400.desc: A safety charm. Keeps you from losing EXP when you get KO'd. \nCan only be used once before it expires.

4140900.name: White Day - Strawberry Candy
4140900.desc: A sweet strawberry candy. Much like the Safety Charm, it does not let the user lose EXP points after death, as long as it's in possession. #cCan be used ONCE within the expiration date#

4140901.name: White Day - Candy Basket
4140901.desc: A candy basket full of love. Much like the Safety Charm, it does not let the user lose EXP points after death, as long as it's in possession. #cCan be used ONCE within the expiration date#

4140902.name: Pineapple Candy
4140902.desc: A sweet pineapple candy. Much like the Safety Charm, it does not let the user lose EXP points after death, as long as it's in possession. #cCan be used ONCE within the expiration date#

4140903.name: Easter Charm
4140903.desc: This will allow the possessor of the item to retain all of the EXP points even after death. The item will be discarded after use.

4142000.name: Respawn Token
4142000.desc: Brings you back to the current map when your character is resurrected. Cannot be used in some party quests, event maps, and vehicles (boats). This item is consumed upon use.

4143000.name: Buff Freezer
4143000.desc: Most #buffs# you had before being resurrected will#c carry over# when you use this. \n#cSome# buffs will not carry over. You will automatically be asked if you want to use the item before resurrection.

4036362.name: Captured Monster Card

4170074.name: Cardcaptor Sakura Random Box
4170074.desc: #cDouble-click# for a chance to obtain a #cCardcaptor Sakura item#.

4170075.desc: #cDouble-click# for a chance to obtain a #cCardcaptor Sakura item#.

4160209.name: Pet Command Guide: Kero-chan
4160209.desc: A guide that contains all the commands for your Kero-chan pet.\n#cDouble-click on the item to open the guide.#

4036468.name: Monster Determination
4036468.desc: The fierce determination of free creatures who resist the powers of darkness

4036488.name: Blank Tape
4036488.desc: A blank tape you can use to film the Lunar New Year video message. Find the Officer of the Day and deliver it.

4036489.name: Video Message
4036489.desc: A video message containing precious messages from the officers to their loves ones. It's been wrapped in silk with great care.

4310263.name: Hong Bao
4310263.desc: These fancy, red money envelopes can be used in the Lunar New Year Special Supply Shop. The Lunar New Year Special Supply Shop is available at the Lunar New Year Party, Henesys, Leafre, and Nameless Town from 01/30/2019 to 02/12/2019.

4036496.name: No-Blessing Charm
4036496.desc: The charm may have lost its power, but a little elbow grease and refining might improve it. Yoria says you should collect 88 of them!

4036497.name: Neinheart's Pocket Watch
4036497.desc: A pocket watch that Neinheart lent to you. He says you should find him when the alarm goes off.

4036498.name: Neinheart's Ringing Pocket Watch
4036498.desc: The alarm went off! Go find Neinheart.

4036499.name: Nyen's Burning Flare
4036499.desc: The still-burning flare that fell from Nyen. You can probably still use this to light the fireworks.

4310258.name: Retro Coin
4310258.desc: It's a Retro World event coin! You can trade it for special items at the #cRetro World Coin Shop#.

4036508.name: Orange Mushroom Doll
4036508.desc:
This cute little orange mush plush is a favorite among tourists, since it's one of the most recognizable monsters in Maple World.
#cHunt Orange Mushroom-type monsters for this.#

4036509.name: Immaculate Branch
4036509.desc:
This is no ordinary tree branch. It's giving off all kinds of weird energy!
#cHunt Stump-type monsters for this.#

4036510.name: Wiggly Jelly
4036510.desc:
This little jelly jiggler looks pretty tasty, but something weird might happen if you eat it.
#cHunt Slime-type monsters for this.#

4036511.name: Clockwork Sprocket
4036511.desc:
There's no telling what this thing is used for, but it's still an interesting curio.
#cHunt Machine-type monsters for this.#

4036512.name: Everfrost Snowflake
4036512.desc:
This beautiful, sparkling snowflake never melts, even when the weather's warm!
#cHunt monsters in cold, snowy regions like El Nath for this.#

4036513.name: Essence of Time
4036513.desc:
This unique souvenir captures a moment of warped time within its crystalline walls.
#cHunt monsters in Temple of Time or Clocktower for this.#

4036514.name: Enchanted Teardrop
4036514.desc:
Some strange magic within maintains this item's beautiful teardrop shape.
#cHunt monsters in water like Aqua Road for this.#

4036515.name: Shiny Erda Fragments
4036515.desc:
There's not much energy left in this, but it still makes for a unique conversation piece.
#cHunt Arcane River monsters for this.#

4036516.name: Glittering Ore
4036516.desc:
The raw form of this mineral gives off an almost ethereal light.
#cHunt monsters in Mines, Dead Mines, and Mountains, or by harvesting Veins for this.#

4036517.name: Dewy Sprout
4036517.desc:
This little, green sprout is the perfect representation of a fresh spring morning in Maple World.
#cHunt Plant-type monsters or harvest Herbs for this.#

4036518.name: Starburst Mana Crystal
4036518.desc:
You can feel a powerful energy from deep within. No one knows what these are really used for, but the one thing that's certain is that these aren't something just anyone can get their hands on.
#cDefeat boss monsters to obtain these.#

4036519.name: Monster Park E Ticket
4036519.desc:
These tickets used to get you entry to the excitement and adventure of Monster Park, but now they're more of a collectible from another time.
#cCan be obtained once Monster Park is cleared#

4036520.name: Famous People Snapshots
4036520.desc: Several photos of the most famous people in Maple World. The best of these will make for a great scrapbook!

4036521.name: Famous Places Snapshots
4036521.desc: Several photos of the most famous places in Maple World. The best of these will make for a great scrapbook!

4036522.name: Famous Monsters Snapshots
4036522.desc: Several photos of the most infamous monsters in Maple World. The best of these will make for a great scrapbook!

4310267.name: LINE FRIENDS Coin
4310267.desc: A shiny coin that looks just like BROWN. CONY probably loves these... You can swap them for all kinds of items at the LINE FRIENDS Coin Shop. Talk to BROWN in #cHenesys#, #cLeafre#,  or #cChu Chu Village# to visit the Coin Shop.

4036532.name: Maple World Leaf
4036532.desc:
This humble leaf is the ultimate symbol of everything Maple World. Collect a bunch for Cassandra, and she'll swap them for a LINE FRIENDS souvenir. 
#cCan be obtained by hunting monsters near your level.

4001897.name: Blue Flame
4001897.desc: This scorchingly hot blue flame might just set fire to anything it comes into contact with.

4036538.name: Unique Sound
4036538.desc: Collect the unique sounds monsters make from time to time to create a Creative Rhythm.

4036550.name: Fantastic Melody
4036550.desc: You've collected the surrounding sound and completed a Fantastic Melody.

4036551.name: Creative Rhythm
4036551.desc: You've collected the unique sounds that monsters make and completed a Creative Rhythm.

4036552.name: Perfect Harmony
4036552.desc: You've eliminated the Poseur Musicians and their dissonant, sub-par efforts to complete a Perfect Harmony.

4140003.name: Safety Charm
4140003.desc: It does not let the user lose EXP points after death, as long as it's in possession. 30% of your HP and MP will be recovered when you are revived. This item is consumed upon use.

4143002.name: Buff Freezer
4143002.desc: Most buffs you had before being resurrected will carry over when you use this. #cSome buffs will not carry over.# \nYou will automatically be asked if you want to use the item before resurrection.

4142002.name: Respawn Token
4142002.desc: Brings you back to the current map when your character is resurrected. Cannot be used in some party quests, event maps, and vehicles (boats). This item is consumed upon use.

4036626.name: Flora Sample
4036626.desc: A flora sample taken from the plants in Masteria. When analyzed in Elpam's research, it might yield important information.

4036627.name: Ecological Sample
4036627.desc: An ecological sample taken from the animals in Masteria. When analyzed in Elpam's research, it might yield important information.

4036628.name: Soil Sample
4036628.desc: A 'soil' sample taken from a top predator in Masteria. When analyzed in Elpam's research, it might yield important information.

4009481.name: Refined Lianium
4009481.desc: A crystallized form of Naricain's Blood, the contaminant that has spread across Masteria. Refined with alien technology, it has much higher purity than conventional Lianium. It might provide essential clues that will guide research into the Antellion.

4310278.name: Raven Ninja Coin
4310278.desc: A coin heavy with the weight of the obligations the Raven Ninja have yet to fulfill.

4310279.name: Shadowknight Coin
4310279.desc: A coin heavy with the weight of the obligations the Raven Ninja have yet to fulfill. This minting is embossed with the emblem of the ancient Shadowknights on the reverse, making it more valuable.

4310277.name: NLC Commemorative Coin
4310277.desc: A special coin with which you can purchase special souvenirs in NLC.

4310285.name: Extravagameza Coin
4310285.desc: You got this coin for participating in Extravagameza! Use it to purchase special items!

4036642.name: Master Circuit
4036642.desc: Core circuitry taken from the dangerous machines roaming Aspire's underground factory. By analyzing these, you may be able to figure out how Scion is still operational.

4036643.name: Krania's Secret File
4036643.desc: A secret file containing detailed information on Krania's various contingency plans for the future.

4036644.name: Basic Machine Part
4036644.desc: Parts taken from the machines remaining after the destruction of the Aspire facility. They may prove vital to saving Spencer's life.

4036645.name: Leftover Machine Part
4036645.desc: Parts taken from the machines remaining after the destruction of the Aspire facility. They may prove vital to saving Spencer's life.

4310284.name: Aspire Memory Chip
4310284.desc: A voluminous log that contains records of everything that took place at Aspire Industries. It would likely be an invaluable asset to any future research into androids and artificial intelligence.

4036666.name: Captured Engineer
4036666.desc: You captured a Reassembled Engineer that was lurking around the hideout.\nBring them to Phoebe.

4036602.name: Isekai Switch
4036602.desc: An inconspicuous, unmarked button. You don't know what will happen if you press it, so it's probably best to avoid the temptation.

4036603.name: Hamusuke's Food
4036603.desc: Food specially formulated for hamsters. Apparently, it's rich in minerals that encourage lustrous, healthy fur, and high in fiber to help with digestion.

4310286.name: Maple Tour Coin

4310295.name: Mark of the Silver Wolf
