4037473.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4037474.name: Phantasmal Crystal
4037474.desc: A mystical crystal that the Seekers found inside the phantasm. Contains the energy of fire.

4037475.name: Card Key
4037475.desc: A card key that can unlock Geardock's security system.

4037476.name: Mascot Power
4037476.desc: Obtained by participating in the #cMascot Parade#.

4037477.name: Pink Bean Token
4037477.desc: You can obtain #c5 Pink Bean Tokens# each time you complete a #cWeekly Collection Mission# by defeating #c2,000 enemies near your level#. Use the tokens you collect for #cMaple Treats enhancements#!
4037477.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4037478.name: Orange Mushroom Token
4037478.desc: You can obtain #c5 Orange Mushroom Tokens# each time you complete a #cweekly collection mission# by defeating #c2,000 enemies near your level#. Use the tokens you collect for #cMaple Treats enhancements#!
4037478.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4037480.name: Churro
4037480.desc: Tasty-looking churros dusted with cinnamon sugar.

4037481.name: Medicine
4037481.desc: Motion sickness medicine that Neinheart happened to be carrying.

4037489.name: Scorched Scripture
4037489.desc: Despite the covers being a little worse for wear, the text remains legible.

4037490.name: Priest's Medallion
4037490.desc: A radiant medallion that proves a priest's affiliation with the order.

4310460.name: Dream Shard
4310460.desc: Earned by #creaching a Lucid Dreaming level#. Can be used in the #cDream Shard Shop#.
4310460.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4037491.name: Black Shadow Mound
4037491.desc: A seething mound of the black shadow.

4310493.name: Special Kroma Coin
4310493.desc: An extra-special coin with Kroma's ever-helpful visage emblazoned on it. Talk to Kroma during #cOperation: Dive# to exchange it for a variety of special items.

4310482.name: Kroma Coin
4310482.desc: It's a Kroma Coin depicting the ever-helpful Kroma! You can exchange it for various and special items by talking to Kroma during #cOperation: Dive#.

4037492.name: Black Shadow Trace
4037492.desc: These traces of the black shadow seem oddly familiar.

4009621.name: Research Record
4009621.desc: A research record detailing hidden dark magic experiments, sought by Alcaster.\r\nThis item can be used for Althea's progression.

4310486.name: Remnant Core
4310486.desc: A Remnant Core obtained from strange monsters found in the Dark Magic Laboratory.\r\nIf you bring it to Parwen, you might get a special item in return.

4350041.name: End Card: Memories with Frieren's Companions
4350041.desc: A picture of Frieren, Fern, and Stark as they prepared to head back to their own world. Reflect on the days of adventure you shared together.\r\n#cDouble-click# to display the illustration.

4037430.name: Condensed Energy
4037430.desc: Condensed energy used to turbocharge power cells while overclocking the Mesotron-S.\n#c- Tradable once, tradable within Account afterwards.#

4037431.name: Liquid Nitrogen
4037431.desc: Liquid nitrogen used for cryogenic cooling while overclocking the Mesotron-S.\n#c- Tradable once, tradable within Account afterwards.#

4350042.name: Space Star Jenny Photo Card 1
4350042.desc: A photo card of Jenny's performance. You can listen to the clean version of Jenny's Meet and Greet music.

4350043.name: Space Star Jenny Photo Card 2
4350043.desc: A photo card of Jenny's performance. You can listen to the Jenny's Meet and Greet Assigned Seating music.

4350044.name: Space Star Jenny Photo Card 3
4350044.desc: A photo card of Jenny's performance. You can listen to the Jenny's Meet and Greet VIP music.

4350045.name: Omega Sector Festival Photo Card
4350045.desc: A photo card containing unforgettable memories of protecting the festival with the M-Force! You'll always remember the allies you fought alongside!

4009606.name: Bejeweled Smithing Stone
4009606.desc: A Smithing Stone imbued with powerful energy, which can be used to significantly amplify special items.\n#cJewels below Smithing Lv. 10 have a 100% chance to enhance +1 level#.

4037451.name: Magic Cloth
4037451.desc: Special cloth used to try on outfits through the #cMagic Wardrobe#.

4037452.name: Mana-Infused Stone Fragment
4037452.desc: This strange stone is thick with mana.

4037494.name: Combat Training Card
4037494.desc: You can obtain #c5 Combat Training Cards# each time you complete a #cDefense Mission# by defeating #c2,000 enemies near your level#. Use the cards you collect in the #cTraining Report#.
4037494.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4037495.name: Special Training Card
4037495.desc: You can obtain #c5 Special Training Cards# each time you complete a #cDefense Mission# by defeating #c2,000 enemies near your level#. Use the cards you collect in the #cTraining Report#.
4037495.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4037496.name: Challenger World - Sol Janus
4037496.desc: #cA Lv. 30 Sol Janus skill that can only be used in a Challenger World.#
4037496.desc_leftalign: #c- The skill can only be used in a Challenger World,\r\nand cannot be used after the event is over.

4310424.name: Adventure Coin
4310424.desc: An #cAdventure Coin# obtained from the Frieren: Beyond Journey's End event. Can be used in the #cMagic Shop#.

4310479.name: Adversary Coin
4310479.desc: A coin containing the energy of an Adversary.\nYou can obtain it by #cclearing the Genesis Pass Plus boss mission#.
4310479.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4310483.name: Basic Bounty Coin
4310483.desc: A #cBasic Bounty Coin# obtained by #cdefeating bosses#. Can be traded to #cHawk# in the #cOperation Ultima base#.
4310483.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4310484.name: Intermediate Bounty Coin
4310484.desc: An #cIntermediate Bounty Coin# obtained by #cdefeating bosses#. Can be traded to #cHawk# in the #cOperation Ultima Base#.
4310484.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4310485.name: Advanced Bounty Coin
4310485.desc: An #cAdvanced Bounty Coin# obtained by #cdefeating bosses#. Can be traded to #cHawk# in the #cOperation Ultima Base#.
4310485.desc_leftalign: #c- Cannot be used after the event period is over.

4037499.name: Etherion
4037499.desc: A cluster of energy containing the power of the #cEtherion Relics# level-up event.\n\nCan be obtained by using #cPrototype Etherion, Activation-type Etherion, Boost-type Etherion# obtained through #cdefeating bosses# or #chunting#.

4037498.name: Augmented Etherion
4037498.desc: A cluster of energy containing the power of the #cEtherion Relics# level-up event.\n\nIt's used as soon as you obtain it, and you will receive #cEtherion x100#.

4037500.name: Bruce's Letter
4037500.desc: A letter from Bruce, who handled the situation at the Golem's Temple. Deliver it to Athena Pierce.

4037501.name: Training Cube
4037501.desc: Can be used in the #cUltima Squad# mini-game. This cube resets the potential of #cUltima Equipment# items. It's old, but it still has lingering remnants of power.
4037501.desc_leftalign: #c* Only usable on Ultima Equipment items with Potential graded Rare to Legendary.\n* Equipment Potential grade will not increase.\n* You can decide whether to apply the reset Potential.

4037502.name: Ancient Powder Keg
4037502.desc: An old powder keg that you may find occasionally in the #cUltima Artifact Hunt#.\nNo matter how long it's been sitting around, it's still terrifyingly capable of exploding...

4037503.name: Ancient Golden Key
4037503.desc: A shining key that you might find very rarely in the #cUltima Artifact Hunt#.\nIt's obvious that it's not just a key... It's an artifact of great power.

4037505.name: Faint Sol Erda Energy x5 Bundle
4037505.desc: A bundle of 5 motes of #cFaint Sol Erda Energy#.

4001969.name: Allotment Card
4001969.desc: A card logging the results of your simulated training, designed to inspire inspectors to ever-greater heights. It can be sold to the shop for Mesos.
